notes.title: New update available!
notes.notes:
After weeks of work, new update of Inexistence is finally available!
So, what's the news:

- Added Time Attack to show at the world that you are the fastest (the scores are registered on the Steam page)
- Added two new languages: German and Spanish
- Possibility to skip cutscenes using the "Menu" touch
- The Map now shows your location in the castle
- Fixed bug that sometimes blocked the hero after dodge back or against some bosses
- Fixed other minor bugs ...

However,I had to completely reprogram the load levels system, to prepare export on Wii U and PS4.
I spent many sleepless nights in beta testing so that everything should be ok, but it's possible that some bugs have passed through my vigilance, please, if you find some, minor or not, feel free to send me right away an email (jonathan.brassaud36@gmail.com) or post a message in the HUB of the game, so I could propose quickly as possible a patch, to avoid the least inconvenience.

Good game !

notes.title: Update and additional content
notes.notes:
Hi!
Inexistence is now available since several days, and the game wins a small succes with gamers and the press, 90% of evaluations are positive!
Paying attention for feedback, and in order to provide a very high quality game, I brought a lot of corrections, correcting some bugs but also bringing new features:

- Additional difficulty mode, for people who love challenge.
- New Skill
- Optimization of battle system and statistics
- Activation of Steam cards and badges
- New Success
- And many minor additions.

This free update is now available, I hoped that these additions will convince you to play on the great adventure of Inexistence, and welcome your feedback on the game!

Regards,
Jonathan

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Here is a new build with the following corrections:
- Adding a indication for the second page of the menu item
- Fixed a bug that prevented having success Champion
- Amended some bugs related to the engine

If you encounter other bugs, please send me email me or contact me by MP, I correct very quickly to make the game as enjoyable as possible :)
